official_korean_air_ir_archive.correction: A prior count of 27 covered only recent English-language filenames and was not the official archive total.

current_consolidated_group.reason: Asiana was deemed acquired on 2024-12-31 and the current group does not disclose a full carrier-wide quarterly capacity, utilization, yield and same-scope cost vector.

korean_air_standalone_segment.reason: Official quarterly IR extends back to 2007 and includes standalone ASK/RPK/load factor/yield plus cargo AFTK/FTK or ACTK/CTK/yield and cost disclosures. Metric-label, accounting and quarter-only bridges still must be audited before calibration is claimed.

asiana_standalone_segment.reason: Asiana's own DART/KRX filings and official aviation statistics may support a separate predecessor segment panel. They cannot be counted as Korean Air observations or combined into synthetic full-group quarters.

unresolved_primary_evidence: bank-loan principal amortization by forecast year
lease payments for each individual year inside the disclosed one-to-five-year bucket
claim-level collateral values and recovery priority
distress sale haircuts and transaction costs
financing_schedule_assessment.legal_alternate_treatment: Use a versioned, wide analyst-prior sensitivity for timing, minimum cash and recovery; show its contribution and never label it calibrated. Treat unverified committed capacity as zero available capacity.

components: Korean Air standalone operating posterior when extracted and OOS-qualified, otherwise disclosed analyst-prior sensitivity
Asiana standalone predecessor segment, separately fitted when qualified and otherwise separately disclosed analyst-prior sensitivity
merger and PMI as a separate structural-break/event distribution
current consolidated filing values as conditioning and reconciliation anchors, not invented history
one consolidated debt, lease, NCI and dilution waterfall after segment SOTP composition
lawful_completion_route.report_rule: The data limitation must widen the range and lower the evidence grade; it must not terminate the final report with no target or entry-price number.

prohibited_repairs: counting two issuers in one quarter as two target-company time observations
using peer-airline outcomes as target-company probability samples
joining Korean Air standalone operating KPIs to consolidated group costs or financing as if scopes matched
backfilling the current group with a simple sum of predecessor companies
assuming the disclosed one-to-five-year lease bucket is an exact annual maturity schedule
hard-coding old-shareholder recovery to zero before an explicit claim waterfall
